```{r}
library(alr4)
data(wblake)

## Data on samples of small mouth bass collected in West Bearskin Lake,
#Minnesota, in 1991. The file wblake includes only fish of ages 8 or younger.

## Age: Age at capture (yrs)
## Length: Length at capture (mm)
## Scale: radius of a key scale (mm)

head(wblake)


fit_full <- lm(Scale~Age+Length, data=wblake)
summary(fit_full)

fit_Age <- lm(Scale~Age, data=wblake)
summary(fit_Age)

fit_Length <- lm(Scale~Length, data=wblake)
summary(fit_Length)

## 1a) marginal plot

plot(x=wblake$Age, y=wblake$Scale, xlab='Age', ylab='Scale', 
     main='Marginal plot of Age on Scale')
abline(fit_Age, col='blue')

## 1b) added-variable plot
fit21 <- lm(Length~Age, data=wblake)

par(mfrow=c(1,2))
plot(x=fit21$res, y=fit_Age$res, xlab='Residual of Length ~ Age', ylab=
    'Residual of Scale ~ Age', main='Added-variable plot for Length after Age')
fit_added <- lm(fit_Age$res~fit21$res)
abline(fit_added, col='blue')

```
